# Security and trust at Plannerly

Everything your IT and security team usually asks for, in one place: how we protect your data, where it lives, who helps us run the service, and the documents to download.

[Email our security team](mailto:security@plannerly.com) [Read our security policies](https://plannerly.com/trust/policies/)

Updated October 2026.

Security

## How we protect your data

### Sign-in and access

Sign in with Microsoft, Google, Autodesk, Procore, LinkedIn or a strong password. On Company we can require one sign-in for your email domain, so your own identity and MFA policies apply. Roles control who sees and changes what.

### Encryption

Every connection uses HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher. Our managed database services encrypt data at rest, and sensitive fields such as integration tokens get a second layer of encryption.

### Private files

Project files are kept in private, versioned storage and open through signed links that expire. Only people with access to the project see its files.

### Backups and recovery

Databases are backed up automatically every day with point-in-time recovery, and we test restores. Our managed platform adds multi-zone resilience and autoscaling, and we target 99.5% availability.

### Tested and reviewed

Every change is reviewed and tested before release, and our code is scanned regularly with AI-assisted analysis. Independent penetration tests run every year; the latest, in November 2025, found no significant issues.

### Monitoring and incidents

Monitoring watches for errors and unusual activity, and we respond around the clock to critical outages and security incidents. If a breach ever affects your data, we tell you without undue delay. No significant incidents to date.

### Our people

Everyone with access signs confidentiality terms, completes security training and, where law allows, passes a background check. Laptops that reach production use full-disk encryption, and infrastructure access uses MFA.

### Trusted infrastructure

We run on established providers with ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 reports for the services they operate. We're preparing for Plannerly's own certification and will share the date once it's agreed.

The application, its databases and your private file storage run in the region you choose: the EU, the US or Canada.

## Where your data lives and who processes it

Where is our data stored?

In the region your company chooses: the European Union, the United States or Canada. Each region runs on its own systems, with its own databases and file storage. [More on data residency](https://plannerly.com/security/).

Does anything leave our region?

Your projects run in your region. The application, its databases and your private file storage - holding your documents, plans, scope, files and comments - all sit in the region you choose. Like any global software company, we also use a small number of trusted services for things such as sign-in, email, payments, AI features, 3D model viewing and PDF exports. Each one is listed below and covered by our [data processing agreement](https://plannerly.com/data/).

How do you use AI?

AI helps with writing, drafting document sections, importing requirements from your documents and our support assistant. It only runs when someone uses it, and people review everything it suggests. Your content is never used to train AI models, by us or by our AI provider.

Can Plannerly staff see our data?

Only authorised staff, for support, through a controlled support session that is read-only by default, opened with a written reason, time limited and recorded.

How do we get our data out, and how is it deleted?

You can export at any time: PDF, Word and Excel, COBie and IDS files, ZIP delivery packages, your original files, and our REST API. When the service ends and you ask us to, we delete your data within 10 business days, as our [data processing agreement](https://plannerly.com/data/) sets out. Backup copies expire on their normal cycle.

Do you have a data processing agreement?

Yes: [plannerly.com/data/](https://plannerly.com/data/). International transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable, and we help you respond to data-subject requests.

Who is your data protection officer?

David Porter is Plannerly's Data Protection Officer. Contact our team at [security@plannerly.com](mailto:security@plannerly.com).

Will you complete our security questionnaire?

Yes. Send it to [security@plannerly.com](mailto:security@plannerly.com) and a named member of our team will complete it and stay your contact for follow-up questions.

## Who helps us run Plannerly

### DigitalOcean

Application servers, databases and queues, in your chosen region: EU, US or Canada.

Hosting

### Amazon Web Services

Private file storage and delivery in your chosen region; also our website and Help Center.

Storage

### Vercel

Delivers the Plannerly web app to your browser. Your project data doesn't pass through it.

Hosting

### Cloudflare

Network edge for our hosting platform: TLS, DDoS protection and bot checks.

Network

### OpenAI

AI features you choose to use. Your content is never used to train models.

AI

### Autodesk

Processes and displays the 3D models you upload, and the Autodesk integrations you turn on.

3D models

### DocRaptor

Renders the PDF exports you create.

PDF

### Adobe

PDF-to-Word conversion and in-browser PDF preview.

PDF

### Cloudinary

Stores and delivers images and logos.
